elements.name: Individual Care Delivery
elements.summary: Individual health assessment, clinical determination, individual care planning, clinical intervention, individual health monitoring and individual care review, independent of care setting, delivery mode, temporal pattern or organisational arrangement.

sources.text: #### 01. Individual Care Delivery

elements.name: Individual Health Assessment
elements.summary: The capability to establish an understanding of an individual's current health state through the collection, consideration and evaluation of relevant clinical, health and contextual information.

sources.text: ##### 01.01 Individual Health Assessment

elements.name: Clinical Determination
elements.summary: The capability to interpret assessed health information and establish clinically meaningful conclusions about an individual's health state, condition, risk or prognosis.

sources.text: ##### 01.02 Clinical Determination

elements.name: Individual Care Planning
elements.summary: The capability to establish the intended clinical response to an individual's assessed and clinically interpreted health state, including the objectives, interventions and monitoring required to progress their care.

sources.text: ##### 01.03 Individual Care Planning

elements.name: Clinical Intervention
elements.summary: The capability to perform clinical actions intended to alter, maintain or otherwise manage an individual's health state in accordance with an established care intent.

sources.text: ##### 01.04 Clinical Intervention

elements.name: Individual Health Monitoring
elements.summary: The capability to observe and evaluate an individual's health state over time in order to identify clinically meaningful change, stability or deviation from an expected state or trajectory.

sources.text: ##### 01.05 Individual Health Monitoring

elements.name: Individual Care Review
elements.summary: The capability to evaluate the progress and effectiveness of an individual's care against its intended objectives and establish the continuing appropriateness of the current care intent.

sources.text: ##### 01.06 Individual Care Review

elements.summary: Managing patient intake, referral triage, appointment scheduling, multidisciplinary care team coordination, cross-facility patient transfers, and care continuity across organizational boundaries.

sources.text: #### 02. Care Access & Coordination

sources.text: #### 04. Diagnostic, Therapeutic & Clinical Support Services

elements.name: Health Products & Clinical Technology
elements.summary: The procurement, inventory control, maintenance, tracking, and biomedical governance of medical devices, implants, surgical supplies, and pharmaceuticals.

sources.text: #### 05. Health Products & Clinical Technology

elements.name: Clinical Quality, Safety & Improvement
elements.summary: Operational clinical quality, safety and improvement: monitoring clinical outcomes; identifying quality and safety concerns; adverse event and incident management, reporting and response; infection control; operational quality and safety monitoring; continuous quality improvement; and coordination of operational responses to identified concerns.

sources.text: #### 06. Clinical Quality, Safety & Improvement

elements.name: Community Health & Wellbeing
elements.summary: Population-wide health promotion, disease prevention initiatives, environmental health management, community outreach, and social determinants of health programs.

sources.text: #### 07. Community Health & Wellbeing

elements.name: Population Health & Health-System Planning
elements.summary: Aggregating epidemiologic data, monitoring public health registries (e.g., cancer, communicable diseases), health service demand modeling, and regional health resource planning.

sources.text: #### 08. Population Health & Health-System Planning

elements.name: Health Information & Knowledge Management
elements.summary: Governing the lifecycle, structure, indexing, durable preservation, and retrieval of clinical health records, medical documentation, and clinical knowledge assets.

sources.text: #### 09. Health Information & Knowledge Management

sources.text: #### 10. Standards, Semantics & Reference Governance

elements.summary: Establishing resilient digital connectivity, multi-protocol integration boundaries, reliable message delivery, publish-subscribe event routing, and secure cross-enterprise exchange.

sources.text: #### 11. Connected Health Services

elements.name: Security, Privacy & Digital Trust

sources.text: #### 13. Health Research & Innovation
